label: ORACLE_ONLY / INVALID_FOR_TRAINING (gradient families disabled; not semantically valid)
purpose: Detect a nonlinear register/latency cliff when a gradient family is removed.

probes.note: register-only probe; paired timing not captured (see note)

findings.register_cliff: NONE. Removing color (-6), conic (-8), opacity (-3) registers reduces counts monotonically but shows NO cliff and NO spill.
findings.latency_effect: ALL paired medians ~1.000 (room nocolor 1.0009, noconic 1.0011). No family removal changes backward latency materially.
findings.interpretation: No single gradient family dominates; backward is not family-compute-bound in a way that DEPREG levers can exploit.
